# FirstLight CR reference attribution

Reference source: https://github.com/luody21/FirstLight_CR

Pinned revision: `28d66cc0a5d65888515e22fdf22f11d783b65efb`.

The R0 named-feature contract and parts of the native phase/special-runtime
layout validation were adapted with changes from FirstLight CR. Its original
Apache-2.0 license and attribution notices are retained in this directory.
Our adaptations relocate functions/vtables for the separately supplied x86-64
runtime and add source/observation alignment and explicit unknown-value checks.
The license does not grant rights to third-party game binaries or resources.
